name: TestimonialGrid
description: Mortar marketing testimonial grid, using central semantic tokens.

props.title: string
props.items: { quote; name; role?; avatar?; featured?: boolean }[] (a featured quote is larger on a sunken card; it spans two columns and rows in the grid layout and every column in masonry)
props.layout: "masonry" | "grid" (default "masonry": quotes flow down balanced columns at their own heights; grid: rows of equal height)
props.id: string (the root element's id, e.g. an in-page link target)
props.className: string (layout only: margins or grid placement)

contract.usage: Import { TestimonialGrid } from @tony-ui/mortar. Compose with the public typed props.
contract.avoid: Do not copy implementations, override central colours or grant component approval.
contract.accessibility: Verify accessible names, keyboard interaction, visible focus, responsive layout and supported states. The root element exposes data-m-component for tests and consumers. It is not a styling hook. Avatars are hidden because the name is visible.
